Definition: from G2380; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively):--sacrifice.
BiblicalUsage: The word thysía is the Bible's way of saying a sacrifice. In Matthew 9:13, not sacrifice, for I am not come to call the righteous. That is the sense it carries through all 28 of its occurrences.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no sacrifice I bring earns God’s favour, because the one sacrifice that counts has already been made. That is why I come back to thysía whenever I need to remember what is true.
